question: Which team won the UEFA Euro Cup 2020 football title?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Italy__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Italy won the UEFA Euro Cup 2020 football title.
 
• The tournament was held in 2021 due to the COVID-19 pandemic but retained the name Euro 2020.
 
• Italy won the final by beating England in a penalty shootout after the match ended 1-1 in extra time.
 
• This victory marked Italy's second European Championship, their first since 1968.
 
• The final was held at Wembley Stadium in London, England. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The UEFA European Championship, commonly referred to as the Euros, is the primary association football competition contested by the senior men's national teams of the members of the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA), determining the continental champion of Europe. Launched in 1960, it is held every four years.
 
• The competition is one of the most prestigious international tournaments in European football.
